purpose: Open-world inventory of contemporary AI computational structures translated into E-CPU semantic Ground intentions, not automatically admitted executable Grounds.
admission_rule: Catalogue entries are source-anchored Ground descriptions. All have ground_admission=catalogued_only; only receiver-owned E-CPU Ground/Virtual Layer admission can authorize execution.
pin_policy: All source references are pinned to inspected public commits. VP2/3/4 refs are stacked draft PRs; do not treat as mainline.
coverage_scope: Modern AI data-to-model-to-learning-to-inference-to-agent-to-operation workflows and shared semantics; new families must be appended as new typed descriptions, not silently mapped to the wrong law.
